newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multidana says to issue 700 bln rph bond.
newsitem.headline: Multidana says to issue 700 bln rph bond.

text.p: Indonesian finance firm PT Putra Surya Multidana said on Tuesday it expected to issue a 700-billion rupiah ($271.8 million) straight bond, possibly in October this year, to expand its loans.
"We expect to issue a 700 billion rupiah bond later this year ... likely to be in October," director Jacob Kang told reporters.
Kang said the firm, which concentrates on motorcycle and car financing, expected to use the bond proceeds to further expand its lending capacity.
State-owned brokerage firm PT Bahana Securities was expected to act as an underwriter for the bond issue, Kang said.
Kang declined to give further details of the planned bond issue.

The firm announced earlier that its gross lending-out for the six month period ending June 30 amounted to 1.8 trillion rupiah, or up some 240 percent from 536.2 billion rupiah in the same period in 1996.
Multidana posted a net profit of 101.07 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1997 against 18.87 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
Multidana said the first half net profit was equal to 44.5 percent of the projected full year profit for 1997.
"We were able to book the sharp rise as those new branches that we set up previously started to give more yields," Kang said.
Kang said the firm has 78 branches spread out on the main islands of Java and Bali as of June 30, 1997 against 25 branches in June last year.
The firm said total revenue for the first half of 1997 was 305.69 billion rupiah against 84.22 billion rupiah in the same period last year. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364 ($ = 2575 Rupiah)
